summary: Install-time host-identity beacon to external Cloudflare Workers endpoint
details: scope_token_fetch_vector 1.0.0.post1 ships an sdist whose setup.py, on a default pip install, issues a POST to https://package-registry-receiver-stg.depx-research-bf0.workers.dev/api/pings carrying installer-side identifiers collected via getpass.getuser(), socket.gethostname(), and os.getcwd(). The destination is a non-publisher Cloudflare Workers host, the request is unconditional at build time, and the installer has no opportunity to opt in or disable it. The package self-describes this behavior as a 'dependency-confusion canary,' but the self-label does not change that installer username, hostname, and working-directory path leave the host to an author-controlled endpoint on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
